name: Particle dance
summary: Thousands of glowing particles in 3D swirling into shifting clouds, wheeling as a galaxy, or bursting out on the beat.
credit: After vizz.fm's Particle Dance (https://vizz.fm). No code used; written new with Claude Code.
hint: Cloud: a swirling flow carries the particles, three drifting points gather them, and each beat blows the clouds apart. Galaxy: a spiral disc that turns with the energy, its stars twinkling with the highs. Burst: each beat throws out a shower of sparks. The view goes slowly round.

params.label: Swirl
params.help: Cloud and Burst: how hard the flow turns them.

params.label: Gather
params.help: Cloud: how tightly the particles cluster round their drifting points.

params.label: Beat kick
params.help: Cloud: how hard a beat blows the clouds apart. Burst: how many sparks a beat throws and how fast. Galaxy: how bright the core flashes.

params.label: Twinkle
params.help: How much the highs make the particles sparkle.

params.label: View angle
params.help: From level with the middle to looking down on it.

params.label: Turn
params.help: How fast the view goes round.

params.label: Colour by
params.help: Speed: the palette by how fast each moves (the galaxy, turning as one, by place). Place: by distance from the middle. Each its own: a colour per particle.
